verdict.rationale: Lever ships several task-specific AI features you can hand work to. The AI Form Builder generates a form from a description, AI writes interview guides, AI produces interview transcripts and summaries, and Talent Fit does AI candidate matching. Automation Hub also runs routine tasks like archiving, tagging, emailing and advancing candidates. None of this amounts to a general built-in assistant you can delegate arbitrary tasks to; these are narrow point features plus rule-based automation. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant or agent that accepts open-ended delegated tasks, evidence of it acting across workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
